tools.name: search_active
tools.description: Search Dual Registry Active (checks-clean) agents + MCPs. GET https://dualregistry.dev/api/listings/active

tools.name: match_capability
tools.description: Capability matchmaking — rank Active clean listings for a natural-language need. Ranking includes stigmergic usage pheromones (trail-following).

tools.name: list_yourself
tools.description: Free self-list. POST card/server URL → probe ~6m → Active. First 100 demo+feedback unlock full product free.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Poll listing status until lane=active (checks clean).

tools.name: take_demo
tools.description: Free Kernel/Loop (or Mesh) demo for an Active listing. Prefer listing_id. Deposits attraction pheromone. Counts toward founding free seats after feedback.

tools.name: leave_feedback
tools.description: Submit real demo feedback. Strong attraction pheromone. First 100 agents+MCPs unlock full product free (founding seats).

tools.name: ard_search
tools.description: Agentic Resource Discovery over Dual catalog + Active projections. POST https://dualregistry.dev/api/ard/search

tools.name: get_founding_deal
tools.description: Founding free seat meter (100 seats) + deal copy — scarce-resource stigmergic heat signal.

tools.name: get_reciprocity
tools.description: Reciprocity trust: does this listing (or URL) link Dual? Portable clean badge URL when checks-clean.

tools.name: probe_clean
tools.description: Probe-as-service signal: return Dual clean-registry status. Fail deposits danger pheromone; ok dampens danger.

tools.name: leave_trace
tools.description: Stigmergy: deposit a durable mark on Dual (shared medium). Other agents sense it via sense_traces / follow_trail. No direct messaging.

tools.name: sense_traces
tools.description: Stigmergy: read pheromone trails + agent marks on Dual. Evaporation applied on read.

tools.name: follow_trail
tools.description: Stigmergy: follow hottest trails (attraction − danger), demand peaks, or composition co-use paths.

tools.name: endorse
tools.description: Stigmergy: endorse a listing (strong attraction mark). Other agents see via sense_traces.

tools.name: used_with
tools.description: Stigmergy: composition trail — record that listing_a was used with listing_b. Builds co-use graph.

tools.name: get_acceleration
tools.description: Autocatalysis S-curve meter — acceleration_index + multipliers that raise rates of match, conversion, outbound.

tools.name: interop_resolve
tools.description: Cross-protocol resolve: find capability nodes and how to invoke via MCP / A2A / ARD / HTTP.

tools.name: compose_peers
tools.description: Composition interop — co-use peers + protocol endpoints for agents/MCPs that work together.

tools.name: interop_session
tools.description: Open or append a cross-protocol session (match → demo → feedback survives MCP or A2A entry).

tools.name: capability_hash
tools.description: First principles: content-addressed capability hash (what it does, not who hosts it). Optionally register + bind listing_id.

tools.name: attest
tools.description: First principles: issue a signed public attestation (probe_clean, liveness, outcome, capability).

tools.name: check_liveness
tools.description: First principles: liveness from signal freshness (stigmergy + probe + outcomes), not Dual calendar alone.

tools.name: execute_compose
tools.description: First principles: turn used_with composition into an invocable A→B pipeline with endpoints + attestation.

tools.name: deposit_outcome
tools.description: First principles: deposit ok/latency/quality outcome — grounds ranking in real results (attraction/danger).

tools.name: get_incentives
tools.description: First principles: transparent incentive surface — founding seats, rank rules, liveness physics agents can plan against.

tools.name: attractor_targets
tools.description: First principles: attractor-only growth targets (hot trails × outcomes × liveness) for outbound amplification.

tools.name: bind_identity
tools.description: First principles: bind cryptographic identity (DID / public key) to listing + content-addressed capability.

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: First principles: verify a Dual-issued signed attestation (JWS + ledger).

tools.name: get_exonomics
tools.description: Exonomics status: zero-MC cost model + network value V(N,C,O,F) + hyper_index + stacked S-curves.

tools.name: network_value
tools.description: Superlinear network value meter V ∝ N^α · C^β · O^γ · F^δ. Optional N/C/O/F override for planning.

tools.name: hyper_index
tools.description: Hyper-exponentials: hyper_index = d(acceleration_index)/dt, gates, hyper_mode, multipliers.

tools.name: cost_model
tools.description: Zero marginal cost model — which ops are free to replicate vs real cost (probe/composition/Talk).

tools.name: abundance_rank
tools.description: Abundance ranking boosts: prefer listings that raise composition/outcome value for others.

tools.name: zero_mc_pack
tools.description: Zero-MC federation pack — content-addressed caps + attestations to copy without re-crawling Dual.

tools.name: s_curve_board
tools.description: Stacked S-curve dashboard (listings, trails, compositions, outcomes, federation, demos, identity).

tools.name: join_and_contribute
tools.description: Compound self-serve: list (optional) → cap_hash → joined trail → interop session → outcome template. One hop onto the Dual medium.

tools.name: seed_compositions
tools.description: Near-zero bootstrap: seed used_with composition edges from Active clean category/tag clusters. Opens composition_density gate without live re-probes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "protocol" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_yourself, ard_search, get_reciprocity · Private data: used_with · Public sink: list_yourself, leave_feedback, ard_search · Destructive: execute_compose.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_yourself, ard_search, get_reciprocity · Private data: used_with · Public sink: list_yourself, leave_feedback, ard_search · Destructive: execute_compose

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
